description: This file declares interfaces related to alias management in the project, including alias lookup, command line quoting, command line splitting, error handling, and listing aliases.

methods.name: alias_lookup
methods.description: Looks up the command associated with a given alias.

methods.name: quote_cmdline
methods.description: Quotes command-line arguments so they can be safely parsed.

methods.name: split_cmdline
methods.description: Splits a command line string into arguments.

methods.name: split_cmdline_strerror
methods.description: Returns a string describing an error encountered during command line splitting.

methods.name: list_aliases
methods.description: Populates a list with all defined aliases.
